name: revmesh
description: Opens STL, OBJ and PLY meshes as editable designs: recognises plates, holes and fillets and rebuilds them as a parametric history. Project: https://github.com/stritti/revmesh

mode.title: Import as
mode.description: auto: recognise features and rebuild the part parametrically (facets become ideal faces; the report notes the deviation); the mesh is kept where nothing is found. File up to 16 MiB. mesh: keep the mesh exactly as it is. File up to 32 MiB

units.title: Units
units.description: Mesh files are unitless and assumed to be mm; inch: the file is read as inches and converted to millimetres
